Common Pepper Pike Questions

Pepper Pike Tree Service FAQ

Six things Pepper Pike homeowners want to know before booking.

Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Pepper Pike?
Yes — Pepper Pike requires a village permit for any tree 24 inches DBH (diameter at breast height) or larger. Roubic files the permit on your behalf as part of the estimate scope. No paperwork on your end. Trees under 24" DBH don't require permits in Pepper Pike.
How fast do you respond in Pepper Pike?
Pepper Pike is a Tier 1 Roubic service area — priority estimate scheduling during business hours (Mon–Fri 7am–6pm) and 1–2 hour response for after-hours storm / emergency calls via our 24/7 line.
How much does tree removal cost in Pepper Pike?
Same Aaron-confirmed pricing that applies across NE Ohio: small tree $400–$800, medium $650–$950, large $850–$2,000, very-large/crane $2,000–$5,000+. Estate-district access on some Pepper Pike properties can push the higher end. Every estimate is free on-site with confirmed pricing before you book.
Do you serve estate properties in Pepper Pike?
Yes — Pepper Pike estate work has been Roubic's specialty for 40+ years. Owner-supervised jobs, ANSI A300 pruning standards, insurance-documentation packet on every storm job, and full owned equipment fleet (no rental gap, no subcontracting).
Are you insured to work in Pepper Pike?
Yes — Roubic carries general liability and workers-comp insurance. Certificate of insurance available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs requiring COI submission.
Can I schedule an estimate online for a Pepper Pike property?
Yes — fill out the estimate form (click any Get Free Estimate button on this page) with your Pepper Pike address, service needed, and phone. Aaron or lead foreman Doug Battiest will confirm and schedule the on-site visit within 1 business day.
